VIDEO SCRIPT: THE GIFTS OF THE HOLY SPIRIT
Grade: Grade 9 · Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn The Gifts of the Holy Spirit. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• discuss the teachings of Jesus Christ on the role of the Holy Spirit
• identify the nine gifts of the Holy Spirit
• classify the gifts of the Holy Spirit according to their categories
• read the scripture provided to get knowledge and avoid being lured to false religion or cults

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN

• Model 4: read the scripture provided to get knowledge and avoid being lured to false religion or cults

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: discuss the teachings of Jesus Christ on the role of the Holy Spirit
• Practise: identify the nine gifts of the Holy Spirit
• Practise: classify the gifts of the Holy Spirit according to their categories

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for The Gifts of the Holy Spirit.”
